title: Asset discovery
description: Hosts and subdomains found under your verified domains. Discovery only queries DNS: it finds published names, it does not probe the machines serving them.

filters.dateHint: Filters by the asset creation date, not by the last checked date shown in the table. The range includes the final day in full.

scan.title: Run discovery
scan.description: It can only be run on verified domains. The work happens in the background and the inventory updates on its own; you can reload to see it.
scan.noVerifiedDomains: You have no verified domains. Verify one in the Domains section to discover its attack surface.

states.error: The inventory could not be loaded.
states.emptyDescription: Run discovery on a verified domain to start building your attack surface inventory.
states.emptyFilteredDescription: Try another type, another domain, another date range or a shorter search.
states.emptyWithoutDomainsDescription: Asset discovery needs a verified domain: that is what authorizes the DNS lookups. Verify one and run discovery to see what it exposes.

toasts.enqueued: Discovery enqueued for {{domain}}. There were already {{existing}} registered assets; they will be updated when it finishes.
